name: nzt-files
description: Browse the project like an editor's explorer: folders that open and close, git marks, what Claude reads and writes, and the chosen file beneath

language.title: Language
language.description: The language the pane speaks: es (español) or en (English)

activity.title: Claude's activity
activity.description: What the tree paints of Claude's work: read-write, write, read or none

follow.title: Follow Claude
follow.description: The tree opens the folders and moves to the file Claude reads, writes or commits

openAtStart.title: Open at start
openAtStart.description: The pane opens beside the conversation when the session starts, when there is room

column.title: Column
column.description: What each row shows at its right: date, age or size

openWith.title: Open with
openWith.description: A command to open files with instead of the system's app: {path} is the file, {dir} its folder (e.g. code -g {path})

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: The rows' icons: auto, nerd (Nerd Font) or unicode

notices.title: Notices
notices.description: The line that says git marks show after git init
